prompt: Create attempt a002, the second and final fidelity pass for the complete 390x818 member-detail sheet. The first reference is the exact Japanese native preview and controls all content and layout. The second is the close candidate. Preserve the profile/header, avatar, identity text, mutual-group row and four action buttons exactly as they are in the candidate; these sections already align closely. Keep all Japanese copy, colors, icon shapes and the date-wrap unchanged. Place the roles card at x≈16,y≈544,width≈358,height≈160. In the candidate its top is about 3px too high while its bottom is nearly aligned; move the card top down to y≈544 while preserving its native height. Place the private-note row at x≈16,y≈739,width≈358,height≈52; the candidate row is about 4–5px too high, so move it down to native y≈739. Preserve the 3x3 role pills and exact copy, membership dates and final right-side 「日」 wrap, plus icon and all other details. No hyperlinks are present; keep every label dark/gray/green, never blue. Do not add any source English text, images, badges, menu or effects.
